title.narrative: Supporting Reconstruction through Smart Fiscal Governance (SURGE)

description.narrative: The development objective of the Supporting Reconstruction Through Smart Fiscal Governance (SURGE) Program for Results for Ukraine is to establish the institutional foundations for implementation and financing of climate-smart recovery and reconstruction. The Program supports institutional reforms across four results areas (RAs). These are: (i) strengthening public investment management (PIM), including integration of recovery-related investments into planning and budgeting systems; (ii) strengthening local public financial management (PFM) systems; (iii) enhancing fiscal governance, including intergovernmental fiscal relations and budget transparency; and (iv) modernizing revenue administration. The additional financing (AF) will co-finance Program expenditures associated with disbursement linked result (DLRs) expected to be achieved between July and December 2025. The AF partially closes the gap and supports the financing of results already embedded in the Program.

title.narrative: Local governments implement medium-term budgeting, building on program and gender budgeting methods.

comment.narrative:
Achieved.
Medium-term budget planning at the local level has been resumed since 2025. The budget proposals prepared by the principal spending units of local budgets, as well as the medium-term local budget forecasts, began to be developed for 2026–2028 in accordance with Article 75¹ of the Budget Code of Ukraine. At the same time, in 2025 the Ministry of Finance improved the regulatory and methodological framework underpinning the legal regulation of all structural elements of medium-term budget planning, in particular: • amendments were introduced to Order No. 534 “On Approval of the Instruction on the Preparation of Budget Proposals” (MoF Order No. 251 of 14 May 2025 “On Approval of Amendments to the Instruction on the Preparation of Budget Proposals” registered with the Ministry of Justice of Ukraine on 29 May 2025 under No. 834/44240); • amendments were introduced to Order No. 314 “On Approval of the Standard Form of the Local Budget Forecast.

title.narrative: Climate change is integrated into the PIM system.

comment.narrative:
Achieved.
On February 28, 2025, the Cabinet of Ministers of Ukraine adopted Resolution No. 527 “Certain issues of public investment management,” which, among other provisions, approved the procedure for the preparation of public investment projects and programs. This procedure stipulates that the preliminary feasibility study must include a basic analysis of the project's impact on the natural environment and climate change, conducted in accordance with methodological recommendations approved by the Ministry of Economy. These recommendations have been developed by the Ministry and are currently undergoing interagency clearance.

title.narrative: Local governments publish information on their budgets, debt and service delivery and reconstruction performance.

comment.narrative:
Achieved.
Information from the Ministry of Finance: Pursuant to Article 28 of the Budget Code of Ukraine, local state administrations and local self-government bodies are responsible for publishing information on: • Local budgets, including reports on their execution, particularly with respect to indicators of local debt and the issuance of local guarantees; • Results of performance evaluations of budget programs, especially those related to service delivery and reconstruction efforts.

title.narrative: Local government budgeting ICT system LOGICA supports performance, medium-term, gender and climate-informed budgeting.

comment.narrative:
Achieved.
As of 31 December 2025, the following enhancements to the LOGICA Information and Analytical System for the Management of Local Budget Planning and Execution (hereinafter — the LOGICA IAS) have been completed: – Local state administrations and local self-government bodies ensure the publication of information on local budgets, including reports on their execution, in particular regarding indicators of local debt and the provision of local guarantees, as well as the results of performance evaluations of budget programs, including those related to service delivery and reconstruction. – An algorithm has been developed for publishing budget documents through the LOGICA IAS on the official state portal “Budget for Citizens”, which is intended to inform the public about the main goals, objectives, and priority directions of Ukraine's budget policy. – The standard form of the local budget forecast has been improved in accordance with MoF Order No. 314

title.narrative: People using digitally enabled services (enhanced services)

comment.narrative:
Achieved.
According to information provided by the DREAM team, as of January 2026, a dedicated public participation module in the DREAM system has not yet been implemented. However, the functionality for project initiators and implementers includes a set of questions on stakeholder engagement, which initiators of public investment projects are required to address during the preparation of the investment feasibility study. The DREAM team has also provided data on the number of users of the DREAM analytics module.
